question: Who among the following was awarded with the 2022 Pulitzer Prize in Feature Photography category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amit Dave**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Amit Dave** is among four Indians honored with the prestigious Pulitzer Prize 2022 in the feature photography category.
 
• Siddiqui and his colleagues Adnan Abidi, Sanna Irshad Mattoo, and Amit Dave from the Reuters news agency have won the award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• First awarded in 1917, the Pulitzer Prize recognizes excellence in journalism, literature, and musical composition.
 
• The categories include Public Service, Breaking News Reporting, Feature Writing, etc.
 
• Columbia University administers the award.
 
• These awards are being given annually in 21 categories.
 
• In 20 categories, each winner receives USD 15,000 and a certificate.
 
• A gold medal is awarded to the winner in the Public Service category of the award.
